datacolumn.scope: Convolve the real part of DATA or CORRECTED_DATA, or preserve the FLOAT_DATA layout.

antenna.scope: Resolve the antenna expression to its first antenna list and select autocorrelations.

spw.scope: Select spectral windows and channel ranges and use a configured kernel of the selected spectrum’s length.

timerange.scope: Restrict the observations by CASA timestamp expressions.

pol.scope: Select the specified correlations and rewrite the polarization metadata.

reindex.scope: Keep original references or reindex selected subtables.

kernel.scope: Use the Gaussian filter or the shifted finite boxcar.

kwidth.scope: Set width in channels, with Gaussian width expressed as FWHM.

outfile.scope: Publish a complete CASA-readable selected MeasurementSet.

overwrite.scope: Exchange the completed product with the existing MeasurementSet after successful processing.

decisions.inputs: Request a channel stripe with no configured convolver and enable overwrite.
decisions.casa: Raises a convolver error after creating an incomplete output MeasurementSet.
decisions.ours: Reports the same convolver error and preserves the previously published MeasurementSet.
decisions.rationale: The new output can be published only after every selected spectrum has been transformed.
decisions.impact: A caller can correct the selection and retry without losing the prior completed product.

paired.kind: Public Python CASA/native comparison and measurement-set interchange
paired.scope: Both convolution families, three data columns, row/correlation/channel selection, configured and missing partial kernels, reindex, publication and six direct tool methods.
paired.result: Independent convolution laws and paired values, flags, weights, identities and spectral metadata agree.
